Applicant :- Devendra Singh

Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.
1. Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Dinesh Kumar Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for directing the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknow/ court concerned to release the applicant on furnishing of two sureties in one case which shall good for all the four cases i.e. (i) Case Crime No.1033 of 2019,
under Sections 406, 420, 409, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Gajipur, District Lucknow, (ii) Case Crime No.1051 of 2019, under Sections 420, 409, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Gajipur,
District Lucknow, (iii) Case Crime No.1052 of 2019, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 409 I.P.C.,

Police Station Gajipur, District Lucknow, (iv) Case Crime No.973 of 2020, under Sections 409, 420,
504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station P.G.I., District Lucknow and (v) Case Crime No.239 of 2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 409, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Gajipur, District Lucknow.

3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that in all the aforesaid five criminal cases, the Devendra Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Gov. ... on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143925039/

sentences.text: applicant has already been granted bail subject to filing a personal bond and two sureties in the like amount.
However, the applicant being unable to arrange two sureties for each case is still languishing in jail.
He, thus, submits that the condition of filing two sureties each be relaxed and the applicant should be directed to be released on filing his personal bonds only.

4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant by submitting that the condition of filing two sureties and bonds is inseperable part of the order granting bail to the applicant.
Therefore, the applicant cannot be exempted from filing sureties bonds as directed by the competent Court.

5. Having heard learned counsel for parties and upon perusal of the record it transpires that the applicant has already been granted bail in the aforesaid five cases with the condition to file a personal bond and two sureties in each cases.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant has relied upon the decision of Apex Court in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vicky vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh in Special Leave to Appeal No.
8914-8915 of 2018, decided on 31.10.2013, in which, Hon'ble Apex Court has passed the order directing the accused to execute one personal bond and two sureties in all cases, in which, he was enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vicky vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
7. Thus, having regard to the overall aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, it is provided that the applicant shall furnish a personal bond of the amount specified by the learned trial Court and one surety in each cases i.e. Case Crime No.1033 of 2019, under Sections 406, 420, 409, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Gajipur, District Lucknow, Case Crime No.1051 of 2019, under Sections 420,
409, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Gajipur, District Lucknow, Case Crime No.1052 of 2019,
under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 409 I.P.C., Police Station Gajipur, District Lucknow, Case Crime No.973 of 2020, under Sections 409, 420, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station P.G.I., District Lucknow and Case Crime No.239 of 2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 409, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Gajipur, District Lucknow, and thereafter he shall be released on bail in accordance with law, if he is not wanted in any other case.
8.
With the above observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of.

(Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I, J.) Order Date :- 22.5.2023 cks/-
